description: Schema-driven detection of update-style actions: input object containing a patch-object property routes to the new patch UX in InputMappingEditor; all other actions render unchanged
Target framing header in the mapping panel: states which record is updated and where it comes from (reference step name / fixed value / expression), derived from the action's id field
Framing subtext: 'Fields you don't change keep their current values' (translated, plain language)
Option C change dialog: two-pane modal with grouped field catalog (left) and authored 'Set <Field> to <value>' change rows (right); unlisted fields summarized as keeping current values
Field catalog groups fields by category (schema-derived: details/assignment/dates-tags/advanced), marks already-added fields, and adds a change row on click
Collapsed step presentation (panel and step card) is summary-first: target framing plus change summary, with an 'Edit changes…' entry point opening the dialog
Change dialog hosts the existing mapping-field components (source modes, pickers, expression editor) without forking them; the inline panel remains for non-patch actions
Change row renders as 'Set <Field> to <value>' reusing the existing source-mode control (Reference/Fixed/Expression) and pickers unchanged
Removing a change row deletes the key from the emitted patch object and returns the field to unchanged state
Nullable fields (e.g. due_date) support an explicit 'Clear value' choice distinct from 'leave unchanged'
Nested patch sub-objects (patch.assignment) render as a single change entry with their existing structured editor and dependent pickers intact
Round-trip fidelity: existing definitions load with exactly their configured patch keys shown as changes; saving without edits emits identical JSON
Plain-language change summary in the panel (e.g. 'Changes Status and Priority · everything else unchanged')
Step card on the canvas/pipeline shows the change summary using field display labels, capped with '+N more'
Advanced collapsed section hosting expected_updated_at, idempotency_key, custom_fields, attributes, and the Raw JSON mode toggle
Raw JSON mode moved into Advanced; switching back to structured preserves parseable field values as change rows
Empty-patch validation surfaces as inline guidance 'Add at least one field to change' on the panel and validation badge, not a schema error string
All new copy translated via useTranslation('msp/workflows') with defaultValue; no 'Patch'/'merge' jargon in primary UI strings
Stable ids on every new interactive element and ReflectionContainer coverage for the new panel regions
All five update actions (tickets, contacts, clients, projects, opportunities) get the UX with zero per-action UI code
Ask-AI transform help and Browse sources affordances remain reachable from change rows where they exist today
Validation badge required-field counting ('X of Y required fields mapped') accounts for the changes model (target id required, patch requires >=1 change)
